html:
Backfill and learn: the two workflows beside the dream

Both run in brain-worker on the devbox's local Temporal (namespace brain), with the dream's ledger, idempotency keys and per-model queues (dream.md). Neither deletes anything; both write knowledge through ApplyEdits.

BackfillWorkflow — a CARD for every work box (DESIGN §4.7, PLAN D2)

plan (det) ──► batch child × ⌈boxes/8⌉, one at a time ──► report .brain/backfill-runs/<id>.json
  boxes: shadow → saahil-docs/*        per box: card (Haiku, card skill) ─► CARD valid? ─no─► ask again once with the reason
         live   → <brain>/work/*                  └► finished? ─► campaign (Opus, distil) ─► notes/ via ApplyEdits
  skip: CARD newer than every file      continue-as-new after 10 batches
  • Where a CARD goes: no .brain/live (shadow) → .brain/staging/work/<box>/CARD.md; live → work/<box>/CARD.md, an older CARD first copied to .archive/backfill/<run>/. The index presents staged CARDs at work/<box>/CARD.md. After the cut-over, brain backfill promote-cards moves them in (an existing CARD goes to .archive/ first).
  • After the backfill the dream's curate.cards refreshes a CARD that is ≥ 1 h behind the work of its box, 4 boxes for each dream, under the dream's $8 cap (dream.md).
  • A CARD is refused when it is over 3 KB, its status is not live|paused|done, a hub is not seeded, or a key file does not exist in the box or is a superseded / .archive/ / log/ copy.
  • Finished campaign = the CARD says done, or the newest file is > 14 days old and STATE says finished/landed/merged. It gets ≥ 1 "what we built and why" note plus lessons; none kept → asked again once.
  • Cost: keys are per (box, skill, input sha), so a rerun pays only for boxes that changed. The cap (--budget, default $80) is on the ledger's total for workflow = backfill, earlier runs included; the $100/day guard still applies. A stop marks the remaining boxes skipped with the reason.

LearnSessionWorkflow — learn/<session8> (DESIGN §6, PLAN D1)

signals (code: note header, transcript tool errors and test runs, lookups shown/opened)
  └► anything to judge? ─► judge (Haiku, judge skill) ─► delta counter ops (helpful/harmful + why) on notes really shown
       └► corrected, judged failure, or tests failing at the end? ─► reflect (Opus, distil) ─► edits

Started by the dream's learn step, one child per new session in turn (≤ 60 per dream, the dream's $8 cap passed in as spent-so-far); the dream applies, lints and can revert the edits. A session whose child cannot run goes to the old batched distil call. brain learn <session-id> runs one standalone and applies its own edits.

Failure modes

Call Timeout Retries On final failure
plan, report, signals, apply 15 min 3 backfill/learn run fails; nothing half-written (atomic writes)
card, campaign, judge, reflect 20 min 2 box or session recorded failed; a model-side error is not retried 
brain backfill run --dry-run          # every box with its planned action; no model, no Temporal
brain backfill run [--boxes a,b] [--budget 80]
brain backfill status                 # last runs + backfill spend so far
brain learn <session-id>
